name: Date-range picker
purpose: Statement periods and transaction search: a From/To pair of Input-fields date fields sharing one anchored calendar panel. First pick starts the range, second completes it, an earlier pick restarts it; endpoints render as the ink knockout with a neutral tint between, and a live region announces the range. Itinerary row 15 (P1); built Phase-2 wave 2 (worker A continuation), extending the Date-picker built the same session.

props.name: from/to
props.$note: DD/MM/YYYY each; both fields validate independently on blur (Date-picker rules) plus the cross-field order check.

variants.name: pair row
variants.use: From/To side by side (Form-layout pair-row precedent); stacks below 520px.

variants.name: open
variants.use: One shared panel under the pair — same elevation recipe and geometry as Date-picker.

$consumes: Date-picker (panel + grid + keyboard model — change it there)

tokens.range: endpoints = ink knockout (text/default + background/default); in-range = form/background/hover — the neutral tint, no new colour minted
tokens.motion: component-type/button-family/press-travel + press-darken (B-D7) on .dr-nav — injection pending conductor registration
tokens.$input-error-slot: OPEN (ADR-0010): still undeclared — binds semantic rag/error (A-Q2).

behaviour.protocol: No selection → pick sets start. Start only → a later pick sets end (and closes); an EARLIER pick restarts the range. Complete pair → any pick restarts. From-field always mirrors start, To mirrors end.
behaviour.open: Either tail button (aria-haspopup=dialog); the view seeds from that field's value (else start, else today); focus returns to the opening button on close.
behaviour.validation: Per-field DD/MM/YYYY on blur; a complete out-of-order pair errors the To field — 'Enter an end date after the start date.' Errors lift on re-validation or on a valid calendar pick.

accessibility.structure: Two real <label for> fields; one non-modal dialog serves both (both tail buttons carry aria-haspopup/aria-expanded); grid = role=grid with full-date aria-labels.
accessibility.range: Endpoints carry aria-selected; every cell's aria-label states its range role (start/end/in range); a polite live region announces range progress — the tint is never the only channel (1.4.1).
accessibility.focus: Two-tier focus (Input-fields decision B); focus returns to the opening tail button on Escape/completion.
accessibility.$note: 3.2.1/3.2.2 met (panel opens from buttons only, typing never changes context — acd-019) but out of relatedSC: not in the compliance lookup (Form-layout precedent).

antiPatterns: Two independent single-date pickers with no shared panel or cross-field check (order errors surface too late).
Auto-swapping an out-of-order pair silently (the user meant something — error and let them correct, 3.3.1).
Tint-only range indication (aria-labels + live region carry it — 1.4.1).
Opening the calendar on input focus (context change — tail buttons only).
Local press-physics CSS on .dr-nav (ADR-0013: injected partial only).
Press physics on day cells (selection targets, not buttons).
